The film is based on Tessa Bailey’s 2021 bestseller, the first installment in the Bellinger Sisters series. “Piper Bellinger (Dobrev) is a glamorous L.A. It Girl whose glittering world comes crashing down after a viral mishap gets her canceled overnight. Cut off from her wealthy family’s safety net, she is exiled to a rugged fishing town with one ultimatum: fix up her late father’s dive bar — or lose everything. There, she butts heads with Brendan (Hoechlin), a gruff sea captain who has zero patience for influencers. He’s the last person she expected, and exactly what she needs.” It will be directed by Peter Hutchings ( The Hating Game ).
